newsitem.title: FRANCE: CIC says appoints Pontet as chairman.
newsitem.headline: CIC says appoints Pontet as chairman.

text.p: Regional French banking group CIC, said on Friday it had appointed Philippe Pontet as its chairman, replacing Bernard Yoncourt.
In a statement, Cie Financiere de CIC et de l'Union European, subsidary of French state-owned insurer GAN, said it agreed the appointment at an extraordinary board meeting held on Friday morning.
French newspapers reported last week that Pontet, previously chairman of public holding group Erap, was likely to replace Yoncourt.
Yoncourt infuriated France's centre-right government for speaking out in October against the privatisation of CIC.
The government later suspended the sell-off.
